reviews.review:
This game helped me discover my obsession with gold and beard care. It's a problem and I don't want to stop. Looking for a Female Dwarf partner who will rear my children, sharpen my axe, and pour beer over me to wake me up in the caves of Hoxxes. Must be able to grow a beard and willing to take risky bar trick bets, and able to hide and care for Steve.

ELVES NEED NOT APPLY.(Unless they have a great/terrible Dwarf impression that will get a response from a bar crowd. Holding your own in a drunken bar brawl is also a major plus.)
Fast action and coop with good class interactions.

This is one fun game if you like warhammer 40k, starship trooper, aliens, predator and so much action movies mix with early 90s fps games than this is for you. if this was around during doom era then it would fit right it it has that fun trill that is often miss now. There is so much you do in this game first is how it feels playing this game you start off going in a deep places and start going cool but as time and mission go on it like you got to keep going and fight you way though. that to me is just fun second thing is i often feel that you could do rp with friends in this game as you have a beer zone and you can drink to battle this feel perfect for socail things and i would love to see videos on youtube on this more. the fact you can buy gear is awesome. missions can take 20 minutes or up to 45 minutes that not bad for any mission. it a game you can play one mission a day or as much as you want. hopefully one day there have a story to add to it if so i can't wait to see it or maybe have the dwarfs sing battle songs. If you took minecraft and add doom you get this and it so much fun. To the guys who made this game Rock and stone mate and have a drink at the bar.
Its worth it, even after 30 min this game is just worth it. Fantastic game
